title: Basic Cell Culture Maintenance: Plating Cells
author: Britt DK Gratreak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pqgdmtw

steps.title: Split cells per prior protocol
steps.instruction: Perform cell splitting according to the "Basic Cell Culture Maintenance: Splitting Cells" protocol; retain the leftover cells from the split flasks for counting and plating.

steps.title: Prepare 1:4 cell dilution
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 75 µL of fresh media and 25 µL of the leftover cell suspension (1:4 dilution). Use a sterile serological pipette to aliquot the media and avoid direct contact of a micropipette tip with the media stock. Mix the contents thoroughly by flicking the tube.

steps.title: Count cells using hemacytometer
steps.instruction: Load 10 µL of the diluted suspension into a Hausser Scientific Bright‑Line™ Counting Chamber (Fisher Scientific Catalog #02-671-51B) and view under a microscope. Count the cells in each of the four quadrants, calculate the average per quadrant, then multiply by 10,000 and the dilution factor (4) to obtain the cell concentration (e.g., 2,590,000 cells · mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Calculate master mix volumes
steps.instruction: Determine the volumes of cell suspension and fresh media needed for the plating master mix using the equation C₁V₁ = C₂V₂, where C₁ is the measured cell concentration and C₂ is the desired plating density (500,000 cells · well⁻¹ for Lipofectamine 2000 transfection of HEK293 cells). Include three extra wells beyond the intended number to compensate for pipetting error. Example calculation: 2,590,000 cells · mL⁻¹ × X mL = 500,000 cells · mL⁻¹ × 15 mL → X = 2.9 mL cell suspension; media volume = 15 mL – 2.9 mL = 12.1 mL. The master mix total is 2.9 mL cells + 12.1 mL media = 15 mL.

steps.title: Label plates with details
steps.instruction: Write the strain (cell line), date, and your initials on each plate to be used for plating.

steps.title: Prepare master mix in Falcon tube
steps.instruction: Combine the calculated volumes of cell suspension and fresh media in a 50 mL Falcon tube to make the master mix. Just before plating, invert the tube several times to ensure the mixture is homogeneous.

steps.title: Dispense master mix into wells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the master mix to each well of the 12‑well plate.

steps.title: Mix plates and incubate
steps.instruction: Gently shake the plate to mix the contents, then return the cells to a 37 °C incubator with 5 % CO₂.
